description: Ministry of Housing & Constructions - Notify under the Construction Industry Development Act, that the Regulations on Registration of Qualified Persons, Registration of Contractors and Technical Auditing Procedure and Fees
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Construction Industry Development Act, No. 33 of 2014, establishing registration requirements, fees, and standards for qualified persons in the construction industry. This constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework matters, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on establishing legal requirements and regulatory compliance for the construction sector.
